items.prompt: A vast dark space filled with a three-dimensional lattice of faint glowing points connected by fine threads, some threads thicker and brighter than others, receding to infinity; it reads at once as a neural network and as a map of galaxies.

alt.ru: Тёмное пространство, заполненное объёмной решёткой слабо светящихся точек, соединённых нитями разной толщины: одновременно нейронная сеть и карта галактик.
alt.en: A dark space filled with a three-dimensional lattice of faint glowing points joined by threads of varying thickness: at once a neural network and a map of galaxies.
alt.pt: Um espaço escuro cheio de uma rede tridimensional de pontos luminosos ligados por fios de espessura variável: ao mesmo tempo rede neuronal e mapa de galáxias.
alt.es: Un espacio oscuro lleno de una red tridimensional de puntos luminosos unidos por hilos de grosor variable: a la vez red neuronal y mapa de galaxias.

items.prompt: A murmuration of thousands of starlings over a winter field at dusk, the flock folding into a single flowing shape in the sky, a lone observer standing small on a path below.

alt.ru: Тысячи скворцов над зимним полем в сумерках складываются в одну текучую фигуру, внизу на тропинке маленькая фигура наблюдателя.
alt.en: Thousands of starlings over a winter field at dusk folding into one flowing shape, a small figure watching from a path below.
alt.pt: Milhares de estorninhos sobre um campo de inverno ao entardecer formam uma só figura fluida, um pequeno observador num caminho em baixo.
alt.es: Miles de estorninos sobre un campo invernal al anochecer forman una sola figura fluida, un pequeño observador en un camino abajo.
